title: Recovered-data strategy family tournament: H12 broad-bear short, H6 funding carry, H7 relative value
purpose: Compare the exact HY-EXP-0032 strategy-family specifications after a narrowly frozen, source-traceable recovery of one immutable mark-price gap. This is development evidence only and cannot authorize Gmail, trading, or an independent OOS claim.
recoveryDisclosure: HY-EXP-0033 was created after HY-EXP-0032 was terminally closed for a non-contiguous mark-price archive gap. Only the data acquisition/recovery policy changes; all strategy economics, risk gates, costs, bootstrap, and winner rules are inherited unchanged.
selectionDisclosure: H12, H6, and H7 were selected after observing prior development evidence. This creates historical winner-selection bias; the tournament is not independent validation and cannot enable email release.

negativeControl.note: HY-EXP-0030 remains closed/failed and is not retuned or used as a positive comparator. Its existing terminal failed registry event is immutable.

sources: PRIMARY: Binance official public historical USD-M archive: https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um
SECONDARY: Binance official public USD-M REST markPriceKlines only for the registered gap: https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/markPriceKlines
dataPolicy.reuseRule: Reuse only the immutable HY-EXP-0032 hash-locked archive files and manifest entries without changing them. Recovery files require exact endpoint/query, retrieval timestamp, raw-byte SHA-256, normalized SHA-256 and a new HY-EXP-0033 manifest entry before any outcome computation.

recoveryPolicy.purpose: Recover only the known HY-EXP-0032 archive gap; recovery is not a general backfill policy.
recoveryPolicy.recoverySourceSemantic: native Binance USD-M mark-price kline rows only; no contract-price, index-price, premium-index, interpolation, forward-fill, synthetic row, or OHLC reconstruction

parityPolicy.semantic: Archive-native and REST-native rows must both be Binance USD-M mark-price 5m data.
parityPolicy.comparison: Exact openTime set and exact normalized OHLC values after decimal normalization; mismatch is DATA_SOURCE_SEMANTICS_MISMATCH and stops before outcomes.

dataPolicy.survivorshipPolicy: Do not select symbols because they survive today. Reconstruct membership from point-in-time archive presence, first available native bars, contract identity/status and continuous coverage. Unknown membership is excluded with a reason.
dataPolicy.qualityFailure: Corrupt, hash-mismatched, duplicate, non-contiguous, incomplete, non-causal or non-PIT data fails the affected family before PnL; no interpolation, forward-fill, synthetic bars, unregistered recovery, or current exchangeInfo backfill.

universe.outcomeSelection: No symbol, pair or cohort may be selected or removed after outcome inspection.

H12_BROAD_BEAR_SHORT.sourceSemantics: Exact HY-EXP-0018 economic semantics; only the development window/universe accounting boundary is specified by HY-EXP-0032. Any economic rule change voids this experiment.

regime.formula: At each completed UTC 4h signal bar, BTC close < its prior 180-bar SMA, BTC 60-bar SMA < BTC 180-bar SMA, and at least four of the frozen six H12 baseline symbols are below their own prior 180-bar SMA. All values are known at the signal close.

entry.formula: When the broad bear regime is true and a completed symbol 4h close is strictly below its prior 120 completed 4h lows, sell at the next valid frozen 4h entry open.
entry.nextValidEntry: The next completed prospective 4h boundary/open with a valid causal contract bar; no later-bar rescue or interpolation.

exit.dynamicExit: Exit at the next valid 4h open after a completed close is strictly above the prior 60-bar high.
exit.stopPriority: Intrabar initial 2-ATR stop takes precedence over a later close-based channel exit.
exit.terminalExit: Liquidate at the close of the last complete 4h bar before the frozen window boundary.
exit.overlap: At most one short per symbol, no pyramiding or reversal.

H12_BROAD_BEAR_SHORT.allocation: At most one position per frozen H12 baseline symbol with equal frozen slot allocation; idle slots earn zero; no compounding.

H6_BETA_NEUTRAL_FUNDING_CARRY.sourceSemantics: Exact HY-EXP-0010 beta-neutral cross-sectional funding-carry semantics; no deletion of the long sleeve, ETH, hedge or funding mechanism.

crossSection.eligibleUniverse: The 12 most liquid PIT-eligible non-BTC perpetual alts from the frozen H6 panel when all requirements are available.
crossSection.fundingScore: Sum realized funding rates strictly after eventTime-14d through eventTime.
crossSection.betaModel: OLS beta and residual volatility for each alt versus BTC using synchronized close-to-close returns ending before eventTime.
crossSection.btcTrendRegime: Sign of BTC log return over the prior 14 calendar days ending before eventTime.
crossSection.longSelection: Three lowest trailing funding scores among the 12 most liquid eligible alts.
crossSection.shortSelection: Three highest trailing funding scores among the 12 most liquid eligible alts.
crossSection.sleeves: Inverse prior residual volatility; normalized alt longs +0.5 and alt shorts -0.5.
crossSection.btcHedge: Negative of selected-alt prior beta exposure.

H6_BETA_NEUTRAL_FUNDING_CARRY.holding: Exactly 14 calendar days from each actual entry; successive portfolios are contiguous and non-overlapping within each execution scenario.
H6_BETA_NEUTRAL_FUNDING_CARRY.observationUnit: One complete rebalance portfolio, never individual legs or funding settlements.

H7_CROSS_ASSET_RELATIVE_VALUE.sourceSemantics: Exact HY-EXP-0011 rolling cross-asset relative-value semantics; no pair deletion, beta-range change, rearm change or hold change.

signal.betaModel: OLS with intercept of y 4h log returns on x returns using only the prior 540 complete 4h bars.
signal.spread: log(y close) minus frozen beta times log(x close).
signal.centerScale: Mean and sample standard deviation of prior spread levels, excluding current signal bar.
signal.direction: Rich y: short y and long beta-weighted x; cheap y: long y and short beta-weighted x.
signal.entry: 5m open exactly 5 minutes after the next 4h boundary, after one full post-signal processing bar.
signal.exit: First later complete 4h close whose frozen-beta spread crosses the frozen entry center; otherwise exactly seven calendar days after entry.
signal.overlap: At most one trade per fixed pair; re-entry requires absolute rolling zscore <= 1.

H7_CROSS_ASSET_RELATIVE_VALUE.allocation: Each of four pairs receives at most 25% gross; within a pair absolute y:x weights are 1:beta and sum to 25% gross.
H7_CROSS_ASSET_RELATIVE_VALUE.observationUnit: One pair trade, never individual legs. Trades sharing an entry UTC day are one dependent event cluster.

commonAccounting.costRule: Compute from gross/executable PnL once. Do not double-count any historical cost already embedded in source rows.
commonAccounting.funding: Include actual realized funding transfers separately, using actual leg direction and mark-price valuation at funding time. Charge every entry and exit leg separately.
commonAccounting.execution: Use the frozen entry/exit timing and fill convention of each source family; no post-outcome delay or exit selection.
commonAccounting.pnl: Report gross, net18, net27 and net36 at event and portfolio level; all values are PAPER research evidence only.

requiredReports.portfolioEquity: Reconstruct one 5m mark-price equity curve with realized PnL, unrealized PnL, funding, reserved costs and realized costs. Closed-equity DD or single-trade adverse excursion is not a substitute.
requiredReports.cvar: Compute daily portfolio-return CVaR95/Expected Shortfall. Fewer than 60 daily observations yields CVAR_NOT_EVALUABLE and the family cannot pass.
requiredReports.riskFailClosed: If true portfolio MTM DD or CVaR cannot be reconstructed, set null plus NOT_RECONSTRUCTED/NOT_EVALUABLE and fail the family.

walkForward.method: Purged expanding walk-forward development evaluation with outcome labels only inside the current training/validation chronology.
walkForward.purge: Remove observations whose holding window overlaps the validation boundary.
walkForward.embargo: One complete maximum-holding horizon after each training/validation boundary.
walkForward.note: No Ridge, GBT, neural, meta-filter or post-outcome classifier is permitted in HY-EXP-0032. This is a frozen family tournament.

bootstrap.hardGate: 95% lower bound of net27 expectancy must be > 0; otherwise EDGE_UNCERTAIN and family fail.

winnerRule.zero: NO_ROBUST_STRATEGY_FOUND; stop research and do not auto-tune.
winnerRule.multiple: Highest bootstrap net27 lower bound; if difference is <2 bps, choose lower portfolio MTM DD. No point-PnL/PF/manual choice.

historicalReferences.H12: Prior H12 development result was selected post hoc and had positive aggregate evidence but failed positive-month robustness; it is explanatory only.
historicalReferences.H6: Prior H6 development result had positive stress PF but long-sleeve/concentration concerns; explanatory only.
historicalReferences.H7: Prior H7 result had 18 pair trades and positive stress PF but best-five and pair/month concentration concerns; explanatory only.
historicalReferences.rule: References cannot satisfy any HY-EXP-0032 gate and cannot be used to tune thresholds.

futureValidation.preparationRule: If and only if a family wins, create a prepared-only artifact with no scheduler, workflow dispatch or Gmail activation.
futureValidation.freshEvidenceBoundary: Any future validation must start after HY-EXP-0033 development and cannot include data <=2026-08-26T00:00:00Z.
